mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cash_balance), 0) FROM USERS) AS totalCashBalance, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mileage_balance), 0) FROM USERS) AS totalMileageBalance, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(point_balance), 0) FROM USERS) AS totalPointBalance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS) AS totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE account_status = 'ACTIVE') AS activeUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE account_status = 'BLOCKED') AS blockedUsers, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM USER_WALLET_HISTORY WHERE asset_type = 'CASH' AND change_type = 'CHARGE' AND amount > 0 AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()) AS todayChargeTotal, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM USER_WALLET_HISTORY WHERE asset_type = 'CASH' AND change_type = 'CHARGE' AND amount > 0 AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS lastMonthChargeTotal
